questions.passage: You can't order a product online without having it delivered in plastic packaging. Dependence on plastic is built into the supply chain, so the individual consumer finds it harder and harder to (A) [opt out / participate]. Of course, you can choose not to purchase products containing plastic, but that only goes so far. I think it is important for you to (B) [inform / conceal] your friends and family of the issue because at the end of the day, companies and governments can't (C) [ignore / enhance] the interest of the consumers.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [해석] (A) 공급망에 플라스틱 의존이 내재 → 소비자가 빠져나오기(opt out) 어렵다 / (B) 친구와 가족에게 문제를 알리는 것(inform)이 중요 / (C) 기업과 정부가 소비자 관심을 무시할 수 없다(ignore)
det.correct: ① opt out – inform – ignore: 세 단어 모두 문맥에 적합 ✅ / ② participate: 참여 → 문맥과 반대 ❌ / ③ conceal: 숨기다 → 반대 ❌ / ④ enhance: 강화 → 불일치 ❌ / ⑤ 모두 부적절 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 opt out(of) = 빠져나오다 ↔ opt in = 참여하다. inform A of B = A에게 B를 알리다(≈ notify). ignore ≈ disregard ↔ enhance = 향상시키다.

det.ref: [논리] 주어진 글(화석연료→해양생물) → (C) 붐박스의 실체(산에 녹인 젖니 소리) → (B) CO₂ → 바다 산성화 → (A) this condition(산성화) → 껍데기 용해
det.correct: ① (A)-(B)-(C): this condition 선행 맥락 없음 ❌ / ② (B)-(A)-(C): 붐박스 설명이 마지막에 흐름 단절 ❌ / ③ (C)-(A)-(B): this condition 지시 대상 불명확 ❌ / ④ (C)-(B)-(A): 논리적 인과 흐름 ✅ / ⑤ (B)-(C)-(A): (B) 뒤 (C) 맥락 단절 ❌

questions.passage: ① Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. ② Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. ③ Many children enjoy playing outdoor sports with their friends after school. ④ According to the WHO, about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day. ⑤ In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장을 고르시오.

det.ref: [흐름] ①②④⑤ = 아이들의 대기오염 취약성 + 통계. ③ 방과 후 야외 스포츠는 대기오염 주제와 무관.

det.tip: 🔑 무관문장: 주제(대기오염 취약성)에서 벗어나는 문장. defenseless ≈ vulnerable. pollutants = 오염물질.

questions.passage: Banksy's art has included environmental messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a plant in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "I remember when all this was trees."
questions.stem: "Banksy's 2010 artwork in Detroit showed a child with a can of blue paint." — 참(T)이면 T, 거짓(F)이면 F를 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] a can of red paint [해석] 빨간색 페인트 통. 문장에서 blue라고 했으므로 거짓(F).
det.correct: T: red ≠ blue ❌ / F: red paint가 맞으므로 blue paint는 거짓 ✅

questions.passage: As the ocean absorbs more and more carbon dioxide, it becomes more and more acidic. Under this condition, the hard shells of many marine species will dissolve.

Under this condition, the hard shells of many marine species will (dissolve / dissolving / dissolved).

det.correct: dissolve: 조동사 will + 동사원형 ✅ / dissolving: v-ing → 조동사 뒤 불가 ❌ / dissolved: p.p. → 조동사 뒤 불가 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 조동사 + 동사원형: will dissolve (○). dissolve = 녹다. acidic = 산성의 ↔ alkaline.
